caption: 01 · IDENTIFY — Can object and file find each other?. Assign stable identifiers to garment, component, container, digital folder, preservation copy, image, and related record; never rely on filename or shelf memory alone.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping can object and file find each other? within A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · DESCRIBE — What evidence belongs to each medium?. Record physical material, construction, wear and condition separately from file provenance, format, metadata, rights, version, and fixity. Link without collapsing.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what evidence belongs to each medium? within A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · CARE — What threatens survival?. Assess handling, light, pests, humidity, storage materials, damage, hardware, software, format, bit integrity, access, vendor, and backup with appropriate specialists.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what threatens survival? within A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · USE — How will access avoid harm?. Define handling, digitization, research, display, reproduction, privacy, cultural restriction, loan, treatment, and correction rules; record every intervention.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping how will access avoid harm? within A Garment Can Outlive Its File.
